overview.about: The AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am is one of the PGA Tour's most glamorous weeks, pairing tour pros with celebrities across the stunning Monterey Peninsula courses - Pebble Beach Golf Links and Spyglass Hill. Now a signature event, it combines world-class golf with Hollywood and sporting stars.
overview.nextEvent: The next AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am is played over the peninsula's ocean-side layouts, with the final rounds at Pebble Beach itself. Wind and weather off the Pacific can transform the challenge from day to day.
